entities.text: High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The hearing has been conducted through Video Conferencing.
Exemption allowed subject to just exception.

1. By this petition the State seeks leave to appeal against the judgment dated 14th January, 2020 acquitting the respondent under Sections 26(2)(i) read with 3(1)(xz) and 3(1)(zz)(v) and Regulation No. 2,4,6,11 punishable under Section 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 (in short FSSA) and the rules thereunder.
2.
Registry is directed to call for the Trial Court Record.

3. List this petition for consideration on 17th May, 2022.
4.
uploaded on the website of this Court.

MUKTA GUPTA, J.
